base.description: The PDU as it ships, the controller in its place.

datasheet.title: Panduit G5 Intelligent Power Distribution Units (iPDUs) specification sheet FBSP28-WW-ENG 4/2024

description: Panduit P42G20M G5 intelligent rack PDU, monitored and switched per outlet, 0U: a 1780 mm strip for a cabinet's vertical channel. It has a fixed 3 m cord ending in an IEC 60309 3P+E 9h 60 A plug, three-phase delta, 200-240 V. It has 42 outlets in two rows: 21 C13/C15 combination sockets and 21 C13/C15/C19 combination sockets, in six blocks. Each block is on a 20 A double-pole breaker across two of the three lines, as the drawing's labels read. A controller with a display, indicators, five RJ45 jacks and a USB-A port sits between the two halves.

gaps.note: the bottom view dimensions 56.0 and 75.0 without saying which is the width; FBSP28 gives 2.2 in (55.88) wide and 2.9 in (73.66) deep, and the strip is drawn 56 wide and 75 deep on that reading.
gaps.wanted: a dimensioned end view of the strip, or a measured unit.

gaps.note: no photograph of any face is held, so no colour, finish, printing or plate shape is checked against a photograph.
gaps.wanted: a photograph of each face of the P42G20M.

gaps.note: no dimension of an outlet or a plate on the front view is stated; the positions are read off the drawing at its own 1780.0 scale.

sheet 1 of P42G20M-XXYZ_DC is a vector page, and `pdftotext -bbox` of it gives no outlet numeral: the only digits in its text layer are the sheet zones 1 and 2, the dimension 20 of the 20 A callout and the part-number table, so there is no numeral to read and none is drawn. The numbering is column by column from the cord end.
gaps.wanted: a front view whose outlet numerals are text.

gaps.note: the 10 A 'C13/C15 COMBO' socket is a C13 outlet with the C15 extension its name states; it presents the C13 key and takes a C14 plug, and no C15 plug is registered, so the extension is stated here and not as a key. The drawing dimensions neither.
gaps.wanted: a dimensioned drawing of the socket.

gaps.note: no view of either sheet is an end view from the cord end: the sheet's BOTTOM VIEW is the far end and the other views show the cord leaving the strip. The bottom face is the gland alone.
gaps.wanted: an end view of the cord end.

gaps.note: FBSP28's row counts 48 outlets, its configuration cells and the drawing add to 42; 42 are drawn and each of the drawing's 42 sockets is one outlet.
gaps.wanted: the maker's statement of the count.

gaps.note: the rear view's callout 'TOOLESS MOUNTING BUTTON LOCATIONS (12) PL' names twelve button locations; only the two dimensioned ones are drawn. The '2X 24.0' and '(4) PL 48.0' dimensions locate marks beside the buttons, and no document says what those are.

the dot lattices, round marks, ringed marks and L-shaped strokes of the long sides and the far end's lattice are drawn from the sheet as unnamed decor and no document names any of them; the outline's small tabs, its edge lines and the end view's front flange are not drawn.
gaps.wanted: a photograph of each long side.

gaps.note: the breaker plates are drawn about 56 along the strip against panduit/g5-breaker-20a's 70.2, which was read for the P24B14M; the part is reused, and the plates are placed on their drawn centres, 74 apart.
the wordmark, the external-ground legend and the legends beside the sockets, other than the breaker legends, are not drawn.
gaps.wanted: a photograph of the cord end and the controller.

gaps.note: sheet 2 of the drawing lists the plain P42G20M only; the key lists six colours, three cord lengths and a bottom-end-fed cord, and note 5 says the views show the top-end-fed cord. The device states the plain part's 3 m cord and 6.8 kg only.
gaps.wanted: an order for each variant that has a held photograph or a dimensioned drawing.

breakers.description: six 20 A double-pole breakers, B1 to B6, each feeding one block of outlets

outlets.mixed: the PDU's 42 outlets, numbered 1 to 42 column by column from the cord end - 21 C13/C15 and 21 C13/C15/C19 combination sockets, each switchable

name: p42g20m

banks.note: drawing - the front view labels the six blocks 'B1 [WHITE]', 'B2 [LIGHT GRAY]', 'B3 [DARK GRAY]', 'B4 [WHITE]', 'B5 [LIGHT GRAY]', 'B6 [DARK GRAY]' and the six breaker plates B1 to B6, each printing the lines it is across: L1-L2, L2-L3, L3-L1, L1-L2, L2-L3, L3-L1. THAT BLOCK Bk IS FED BY BREAKER Bk IS A READING OF THE LABELS: no sentence held says it. The three greys are drawn as #e4e5e7, #9a9da1 and #55585c and are estimates of the words: no photograph is held.

capability.note: datasheet - the drawing's unit type is MONITORED & SWITCHED PER OUTLET and FBSP28 lists it under the MSPO series, so `metering-scope: outlet` and `outlet-switching: true`, and each outlet declares [on, off].

chassis.note: drawing - 1780.0 long (front view), 56.0 and 75.0 on the bottom view; FBSP28 gives 2.2 in (55.88) wide and 2.9 in (73.66) deep, which supports 56.0 as the width and 75.0 as the depth, though the drawing does not label them (gaps: body-width). Weight 6.8 kg is the sheet-2 table's only row.

colour.note: drawing - sheet 2 gives BLACK (RAL 9005) for the plain part number P42G20M, drawn here as the RAL's #0e0e10 on the body. THE PLATE, MOULDING AND SCREW COLOURS ARE NOT CHECKED against any source; no photograph is held.

controller.note: drawing - the controller plate ('NMC SHOWN IN DEFAULT ORIENTATION') is drawn between the third and fourth breaker plate, about 137 along against the component's 127.8; the bay is centred on it. P42G20M is composed with panduit/g5-controller@1 in a bay because the FBSP28 sheet calls the controller hot swappable. Its jacks' functions are not read.

ends.note: ESTIMATED from the vector paths - the sheet's BOTTOM VIEW is the far end, the library's top face: a 10 by 10 lattice of 4.0 mm dots on a 5.0 mm pitch and a 26 mm plate along the rear edge, drawn as unnamed decor. No sheet or view shows the cord end as an end view (the cord leaves the strip in the other views), so the bottom face is the cord gland alone (gaps: cord-end-face).

front.note: drawing - the front view. From the cord end: a plate with the external ground, three breaker plates B1 to B3, three blocks of four columns of two outlets, the controller, three breaker plates B4 to B6, and three blocks of three columns, to the far end. Plate and outlet positions are the centres as drawn; the outlet pitch is not dimensioned. The column pitch is 37.1, read off the first half, and is kept in the second where the drawing reads about 39.

input.note: drawing - 'INPUT PLUG: IEC 60309 3P+E 9H 60A (IP44)', 'INPUT VOLTAGE: 200-240VAC', 'INPUT CURRENT: 60A (48A DERATED)', 'INPUT PHASE: THREE-PHASE, DELTA', 'RATED POWER: 17.3 KVA'. Sheet 2 gives the plain part number a 3 m cord. The cord is one part at the cord end; its length and the plug's face are not drawn.

method.note: FIGURES FROM THE MAKER'S VECTOR DRAWING. Panduit customer drawing P42G20M-XXYZ_DC rev 01A (12/22/2022), two sheets, has a front, rear, left, right and bottom view. Its scale was taken from its own 1780.0 overall dimension (the 1555.0 between the buttons agrees) and every position was read off renderings of the front view at 400 dpi, to about 1 mm across and 3 mm along the strip. The library draws the PDU STANDING, cord end down, so a position along the drawing becomes 1780 minus that, and a position across becomes x. No photograph and no 3D model of the part is held.

mount.note: `rack-side`: the strip stands beside a rack's upright on two mounting buttons on its back, 1555.0 apart and 40.5 from the cord end (rear view). The drawing says 'VERTICAL, 0U' and gives no count of units; `ru: 40` is the whole units the 1780 mm length covers (40.04) and is not stated by any document.

outlets.note: drawing - '(21)C13/C15, (21)C13/C15/C19'; the receptacle block draws each as ONE SOCKET named 'C13/C15 COMBO 10A' and 'C13/C15/C19 COMBO 16A', so each is one outlet. The upper row of the front view is the C13/C15 and the lower row the C13/C15/C19 (x = 4 and 28). FBSP28 counts 48 outlets in its row and lists the C21 as well; the drawing's 21 and 21 are used. The outlets are numbered 1 to 42 column by column from the cord end, the upper socket first: THE NUMBERING IS AN ASSUMPTION, the sheet's text layer holds no outlet numeral (gaps: outlet-numerals). THE WAY UP OF EACH SOCKET IS NOT READ: both are drawn unturned.

rear.note: drawing - the rear view: two buttons 40.5 from the cord end and 1555.0 apart, on the strip's centre line. The callout 'TOOLESS MOUNTING BUTTON LOCATIONS (12) PL' names twelve button locations and only the two dimensioned ones are drawn (gaps: rear-marks).

sides.note: ESTIMATED from the vector paths of sheet 1 of P42G20M-XXYZ_DC (the sheet stacks FRONT, RIGHT, REAR and LEFT upward and puts BOTTOM beside FRONT, as a third-angle unfold does, and shows the cord at the top end; the library stands the strip cord end down with the front still toward the viewer, a half turn in the plane; 3.1801 mm to the sheet point, scaled on the 1780.0 overall dimension, which is 559.74 pt between its extension lines). The sheet's LEFT VIEW is the library's right face and its RIGHT VIEW the library's left face, because the sheet draws the strip standing cord end up; the two views agree on the 62.9 mm line of single marks and on the 48.0 of the four ringed marks that the sheet dimensions '(4) PL 48.0', which checks the mapping. Drawn as unnamed decor: the dot lattices as rectangles of 4.0 mm dots on a 5.0 mm pitch (1662 dots on the right face, 1748 on the left, in 32 and 30 rectangles), the round marks 9.3 mm across (single and paired), the four ringed marks 7.8 mm across, the three 4.1 mm dots of the left face and the two L-shaped strokes of the right face. Each position is good to about 1 mm. No function is stated for any mark. The sheet's small tabs along the front edge, the edge lines and the cord gland are the strip's outline and are not drawn (gaps: side-marks).
